    • compile

      public static EngineeringDeliverableCompiler.CompilationResult compile(EngineeringProject project, Path outputDirectory, EngineeringGraph baselineGraph) throws IOException
      Compiles all current engineering deliverables and optionally compares them with a previous graph revision.
      Parameters:
      project - governed engineering project
      outputDirectory - target package directory
      baselineGraph - optional prior revision for change-impact reporting
      Returns:
      compilation result
      Throws:
      IOException - if any artifact cannot be written
